scope.checks: Same five r10 configurations through actual API-005 SSE; deterministic final validation; inspect all five full raw outputs; check DB settlement. No full-site regression.
scope.routing_caveat: Luna uses existing generic OpenRouter route with require_parameters/data_collection=deny; MiniMax and GLM baseline pinned Together with no fallback. metadata_note: Five read-only authenticated GET /generation?id=... queries using existing credential in memory; no further inference. Exact model/provider and total_cost from OpenRouter. Cost is reported usage, not independently reconciled invoice. Negative cache_discount recorded as returned; not interpreted as cache hits. native_tokens_cached=0.
